Interfaith Food Pantry, 435 Stafford Run, Stafford TX 77477. Tue/Thu/Fri 10:00am-12:30pm; once per week for qualified East Fort Bend County residents. Bring photo ID and proof of address; proof of income/expenses if available. No appointment.
Select Wednesday evening session, 435 Stafford Run, Stafford TX 77477. Wed Nov 11, 6:00-8:00pm; next listed evening date on the org page. Same ID and proof-of-address requirements as daytime pantry.

8888 W Bellfort Ave, Houston. Wed Nov 11, 10:30-11:30am with Houston Food Bank; first 250 families, arrive early, registration/token may close early. Open to all regardless of background. Future dates Nov 25, Dec 9 and 23.

1111 Collins Rd, Richmond. Community Food Distribution weekly, no appointment: Mon 12:00-2:30pm, Tue and Wed 9:00am-2:30pm; fresh produce, bakery, proteins, dairy, shelf-stable. Monthly Community Food Fair date not published on the centre page — check the schedule link. Trini's Market (age 60+) by appointment.

1135 Highway 90A, Missouri City. Park and Pickup groceries, mobile pantry and community food fairs; Choice Pantry by appointment, about once every two weeks. No pickup schedule published on the site — call first. Serves Fort Bend County residents at or below 185% of the federal poverty level; ID required.

5645 Hillcroft Ave Ste 405, Houston. Halal food pantry, registration/by-appointment only. Hours per directory listing Tue-Fri 1:00-6:00pm and Sat 12:00-3:00pm — not confirmed on the org site this run.

6856 Bellaire Blvd, Houston. Emergency Services Southwest: Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri 10:00am-2:00pm, Sat 9:00am-12:00pm. 5-day food packages, first-come first-served with a daily limit, arrive early; no appointment for food; interview to qualify; serves listed ZIP codes including 77401.
